details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Wednesday through Monday. There is a Marginal Risk, or level 1 out of 5, for thunderstorms with damaging wind gusts Wednesday afternoon south of Interstate 70 as a cold front crosses the region. Another cold front is expected to bring showers and strong wind gusts to 35-45 mph across the region on Friday. A much colder airmass in its wake will arise frost and freeze concerns both Friday and Saturday night.
